dct_description_sm: This dataset contains Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping products for activation EMSR930. On the 2 September 2026, at 13:00 UTC a storm was reported to have affected the cities of Policoro and Scanzano Jonico, in the Basilicata region, Italy. The storm hit the cities, the coast and the countryside, downing trees, damaging beach establishments, structures and greenhouses, ripping off roofs and causing power outages. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide damage assessment emergency mapping. **Citation:** Copernicus Emergency Management Service (© 2026 European Union), EMSR930 **Product types present in this dataset's resources:** **GRA (Grading)**: assesses damage to individual features (eg. buildings, infrastructure). Where a GeoPackage download is available for an Area of Interest/round, it already contains every layer with its official Copernicus styling and colours - prefer it in GIS software over the zipped shapefile download.
